items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: A guy like Ozawa in front of an orchestra for Christ’s sake... And then you look and there’s Ozawa up there glaring at everybody

ctx.x: You had shared a little lesson that I’d like to hear about again, and that was getting your students to play an F scale —

Oh yeah. Well the thing is, here’s the bottom line for me and what I was delving into, and I’m sorry you’d know that I kissed the Blarney stone at one time you know, I have this gabbing kind of gift that I keep going. But I take these asides in conversation quite often. But the thing about it that I was getting at is that music is basically an emotional thing. It’s not supposed to be just a clinical, don’t-miss-a-note kind of thing. And that’s what’s happened to music education over the years to a point where you…
Yes. I’ve often wondered why nobody in an orchestra seems to ever smile.
